items.question: In what year did the Abu Dhabi Judicial Department introduce its Family Guidance Program, the first of its kind in the GCC region?
items.fact: Abu Dhabi Family Guidance Program introduced in 2020

items.question: Under the UAE Personal Status Law, can wills and inheritance cases be referred to the Family Guidance and Reconciliation Centre for amicable settlement?
items.gold: No, wills and inheritance cases are excluded from referral.
items.fact: Wills and inheritance excluded from family reconciliation referral
